svg.aria-label: The forty-one chapters of release candidate 2 in ten columns, one per part, each a tile as tall as the chapter is long, coloured from red (readers lost interest) to green (readers held). Part 1 and the making-of are mostly amber; the frame, working with agents and judgement are greener; the two company chapters, 22 and 37, are short dashed placeholders, and 37, 39, 40 and 41 carry the marks where readers put the book down.

text.tspan: THE BOOK AT THE TOP ALTITUDE · RELEASE CANDIDATE 2
Generation ZX Founders, on one page
Every chapter of the release candidate, by part, in the printed order. A tile's height is the chapter's length; its
colour is how the five synthetic readers held there. Drawn from the candidate and the study, not by hand:
How the five synthetic readers held, mean interest out of 5:
readers who put the book down there
Tile height is the chapter's length: 73,314 words in all.
Source: v2/content/ (release candidate v2.0.0-rc2) and admin/content/readers/01-rc2/runs/ (five invented
readers, Claude Sonnet, 19 October 2026). Interest is the readers' own mark, 1 to 5, averaged over every step
that read or skimmed the chapter.
the-book-on-one-page · drafted by code, not reviewed
